description: This file provides functions and types for parsing and handling HTTP headers, including parsing Accept headers and defining octet types based on RFC 2616.

methods.name: ParseAccept
methods.description: Parses Accept* headers from an HTTP request header.

methods.name: skipSpace
methods.description: Skips whitespace characters in a string.

methods.name: expectTokenSlash
methods.description: Extracts a token possibly followed by a slash from a string.

methods.name: expectQuality
methods.description: Parses the quality value (q) parameter from a string.
